subject.why: The boots are instantly recognizable cowboy boots featuring pull tabs, heels, and cream stars as requested.

category.why: The boots rest on a plain flat surface with a smooth wall gradient behind, cleanly adhering to category 2.

clean.why: There is no text, UI, borders, or extra characters.

framing.why: The pair forms a cohesive, centered focal point with comfortable margins on all sides.

colour.why: Rich warm brown boots contrast strongly against the fresh green backdrop, with the tabletop clearly lighter than the wall.

detail.why: The stitching is simplified into chunky, stylized 3D dashes without micro-textures or busy clutter.

style.why: The rendering features smooth chunky volumes, soft satin sheen, and clean lighting consistent with the game's art style.

bg_colour.why: background is green (100% of the background); planned green
